messages:
Anna: Quick sync — we need a stable mapping between failure types and HTTP status + headers. debating quotas vs capacity vs fallback UX.
Ravi: My take: quotas => 429, capacity short-term => 503, policy/forbidden => 403. Also add a machine-readable header for telemetry like `x-rw-error-code`.
Leo: Concern: people treat 5xx as always retryable. if we use 503 for capacity we must include a non-retry hint so SDKs don't thundering herd.
Maya: Console side: want deterministic badges: throttled, degraded, fallback. Those badges must map 1:1 to status+header so customers see consistent messaging.
Anna: Proposal:
```
quota -> 429 + x-rw-error-code: QUOTA_EXCEEDED + x-rw-quota-reset: <seconds>
capacity_overflow -> 503 + x-rw-error-code: CAPACITY_OVERFLOW + x-rw-fallback-tier: <tier>
client_bad_request -> 400 + x-rw-error-code: BAD_REQUEST
policy_block -> 403 + x-rw-error-code: POLICY_BLOCKED
```
Ravi: Add `x-rw-retryable: 0|1` so SDKs can decide. telemetry team wants a stable `error_class` field as well (quota|capacity|policy|client).
Leo: SDK behaviour: if `x-rw-retryable: 0` -> do not auto-retry. If 1 -> exponential backoff. that solves the 503 problem.
Maya: Console copy suggestion for quota: "Request limit reached — reduce rate or upgrade quota. See Insights > Quotas." For fallback: "Degraded: auto-fell back to a smaller model to preserve latency."
Anna: Small code example we'll ship in SDK docs:
```
if (resp.headers['x-rw-retryable'] === '0') {
  // do not retry automatically
}
```
Ravi: Rollout plan: expose headers in hosted canary and Dedicated opt-in. Then monitor telemetry for `error_class` and `x-rw-error-code` spikes for 48h.
Maya: Add acceptance tests: ensure header presence for each failure simulation, and console badge flips accordingly.
Leo: Telemetry needs mapping table in RFC. i'll add `error_class` tag + metric `api.failure_by_class` and alert when quota failures > baseline.
Anna: I'll draft RFC and include the mapping table and rollout checklist. target: canary next week.
deploy-bot: deploy started to eng-platform-canary for header-exposure flag (rollout 10%).
Ravi: Also note: avoid putting user-friendly strings in headers. headers must be machine-friendly keys only. Console should translate codes -> friendly messages.
Maya: +1 :thumbsup: will prepare console copy variants for i18n.
Anna: ok locking in mapping and docs PR incoming. thanks all.
